question: Of what nature are the filaments of the ritual seat declared to consist?
premises: The seat has filaments as parts.
These filaments are described in the teaching.
They are said to consist of transformations.
inference: The filaments of that seat are declared to consist of transformations.
uncertainties: vikāra-maya may refer to specific cosmic transformations in this system
plain_english: Its filaments are declared to consist of transformations.
